samples.summary: New test codifies exit 1 / code ERROR for a backend 5xx, contradicting the design doc's error matrix (§10: "Backend 5xx or network | 2 | SYSTEM")
samples.evidence: output.test.ts:269-278 asserts `docs get` against a 500 yields `{code:'ERROR',message:'HTTP 500'}` with `process.exitCode === 1`. docs/design/cli.md:952 specifies exit 2 / code SYSTEM for backend 5xx and network errors. The issue's non-goals say "No change to exit codes, error codes", so the divergence is pre-existing — but the change now pins the divergent behavior in a regression guard without noting it, making the spec gap harder to close later.

samples.summary: The doc bullet the diff amends still says the error envelope is "a single JSON line on stderr", while `outputError` pretty-prints it across multiple lines
samples.evidence: docs/design/cli.md:930-935 (the bullet extended by this diff) describes "a single JSON line on stderr"; packages/cli/src/output/formatter.ts:53-56 emits `JSON.stringify({...}, null, 2)`, i.e. an indented multi-line object. Since the change is explicitly about making this envelope the machine-readable failure signal and touches this exact bullet, the line-shape mismatch should have been reconciled (either doc or code).

samples.summary: Switching the entrypoint from `parse()` to `parseAsync().catch(...)` is scope beyond the issue plan (steps 1-7 cover formatter, call sites, flag help, tests, docs only)
samples.evidence: docs/tasks/active/20260806-cli-quiet-preserves-body-todo.md lists 7 plan items and 3 acceptance criteria, none of which mention the commander entrypoint; the change nonetheless alters global promise/exit-code semantics for every command (bin.ts:28-37). It is defensible as making the envelope actually reachable for async rejections, but it is an unrequested behavioral change to the entrypoint and its justification lives only in a code comment, not in docs/design/cli.md. The accompanying test also asserts on `bin.ts` source text rather than behavior, which cements an implementation detail.

samples.summary: The envelope emitted still omits the `command` field documented in docs/design/cli.md §9, in the same change that elevates the envelope to "the machine-readable failure signal"
samples.evidence: docs/design/cli.md:930-931 documents `{"error":{"code":"…","message":"…","command":"docs.content"}}`; formatter.ts:53-56 emits only `code` and `message`. The branch's own lessons note (docs/tasks/active/20260806-cli-quiet-preserves-body-lessons.md:22-24) declares this out of scope, so this is informational only — but the doc bullet is now expanded in this diff while still promising a field the code never emits.
